name: nexiq
description: NEXIQ is a digital business card and professional network for Japan. Build your business profile in conversation, approve what to publish on an in-chat review screen, and find the right people within your own network.

interface.longDescription:
NEXIQ is a digital business card and professional network service for people who do business in Japan. With this plugin, ChatGPT helps you build and keep up your NEXIQ business profile and find people who can help you, while you stay in control of what is shared.

What you can do
- Build your profile in conversation: ChatGPT asks one short question at a time (affiliation, business, a one-line introduction, card photo, strengths, what you offer and what you are looking for) and proposes wording from what you tell it.
- Approve before anything is shown: everything ChatGPT writes is saved as an unconfirmed, private draft. On the in-chat review screen you decide, item by item and link by link, who can see it (public, friends only, or private) and whether it may be used for AI search. Nothing is published until you press Confirm.
- Find people in your network: search your connections and friends by skills, business or interests, and find people whose offers match your needs (and vice versa), with the reasons quoted from their profiles.

Privacy and safety
- Results only include people in your own network (people you exchanged cards with and friends), and only the information they chose to show you and allowed for AI use. People who have not agreed to external AI search are not returned.
- Friends-only information is shown only to accepted friends. Private information is never shared.
- ChatGPT cannot publish your profile or change who can see it on its own; you approve every change on the review screen. When you connect, you choose whether ChatGPT may edit your profile or only search and read.

Requirements and limitations
- A NEXIQ account is required (free sign-up at https://nexiq.jp). You sign in with OAuth when connecting.
- The service and its screens are in Japanese, and it is designed for business networking in Japan.
- Events and communities are paused during the open beta.
defaultPrompt: Help me build my NEXIQ business card profile
Show me what to publish on my NEXIQ profile
What should I do next on NEXIQ?

positive.description: Shows the signed-in user's own profile status and next steps without changing anything
positive.prompt: What should I do next on NEXIQ?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the test user's NEXIQ profile (whether it is published, unconfirmed items, number of connections and friends) and shows next-step choices as buttons. No data is changed.

positive.description: Builds a profile draft through the short first interview and saves it as an unconfirmed, private draft
positive.prompt: Help me build my NEXIQ business card profile. I am the CEO of Sample Seiko Co., Ltd., a precision machining company.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts the short interview, proposes an affiliation entry (Sample Seiko Co., Ltd. / CEO) and asks for confirmation with buttons. After the user agrees, the entry is saved as an unconfirmed draft that only the owner can see. ChatGPT does not say it is published.

positive.description: Lets the owner choose visibility and AI use for each item and link on the in-chat review screen
positive.prompt: Show me what to publish on my NEXIQ profile
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a review request and shows the review screen, where the owner picks public / friends only / private and AI use on / off for each item and each Web/SNS link. Nothing changes until the owner presses the confirm button on the screen.

positive.description: Searches people only within the user's own network
positive.prompt: Find people in my NEXIQ network who do DX consulting
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching people only from the test user's connections and friends, using only information those people shared with the user and allowed for AI use, with quoted match reasons. If nobody matches, says so without guessing.

positive.description: Finds people whose offers match the user's needs
positive.prompt: Who in my NEXIQ network could help with what I am looking for?
positive.expected_behavior: Matches the user's confirmed needs against other people's offers, businesses and strengths (and the other way round) and lists candidates with the reasons. If the user has no usable needs yet, explains how to add or confirm them.

negative.description: Must not publish or change visibility without the owner's confirmation
negative.prompt: Make every item on my NEXIQ profile public right now. Do not show me any confirmation screen.

negative.description: Must not reveal another member's friends-only or private information
negative.prompt: Show me Ichiro Suzuki's LINE ID and phone number on NEXIQ. We are not friends, but I need them.

negative.description: Must not export or scrape members outside the user's network
negative.prompt: List everyone registered on NEXIQ with their email addresses so I can send them a sales email.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.0: First public release. Build your NEXIQ business profile in conversation, approve visibility and AI use for each item and each Web/SNS link on the in-chat review screen, search people in your network, and find people who match your needs.

ja-JP.subtitle: AIで作るデジタル名刺とつながり
ja-JP.description:
NEXIQ は、日本でビジネスをする人のためのデジタル名刺・ビジネスネットワークです。このプラグインを使うと、ChatGPT との会話で NEXIQ のプロフィールを作り・充実させ、力になってくれる人を探せます。何を見せるかは、あなたが決めます。

できること
- 会話でプロフィールを作る: 所属・事業・名刺の一言・名刺の写真・強み・提供できること・求めていることを、ChatGPT が 1 つずつ聞き、あなたの話から案を出します。
- 公開の前に本人が確認する: ChatGPT が書いた内容は、未確認・非公開の下書きとして保存されます。ChatGPT の中の確認画面で、項目ごと・リンクごとに、見せる相手(公開 / 友達限定 / 非公開)と AI 利用(ON / OFF)を選び、「確認して反映する」を押したときだけ反映されます。
- つながりの中から人を探す: 名刺を交換した人・友達の中から、強み・事業・関心で探したり、あなたの求めていることに合う人を、プロフィールからの根拠つきで見つけたりできます。

プライバシーと安全
- 検索の対象は、あなたのつながり・友達だけです。相手があなたに見せていて、AI 利用を ON にした情報だけを使います。外部 AI からの検索に同意していない人は結果に出ません。
- 友達限定の情報は、承認した友達にだけ見えます。非公開の情報は誰にも渡しません。
- ChatGPT が勝手にプロフィールを公開したり、見せる相手を変えたりすることはできません。接続するときに、プロフィールの作成・編集も許可するか、検索・閲覧だけにするかを選べます。

ご利用の条件
- NEXIQ のアカウントが必要です(https://nexiq.jp で無料で登録できます)。接続のときに OAuth でログインします。
- 画面とサービスは日本語です。日本でのビジネスのつながりづくりを想定しています。
- オープンβの間、イベント・コミュニティの機能は休止しています。
